question: Three of the following letter-clusters are alike in some manner and hence form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- The difference between first two and last two letter's position value is 7 and 10 respectively according to English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• Option - (1) : CGB

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d9aabe8c3ab9290fa68885d2461e783e32f4a2bdce2b168dae8f56409f076e2.png] 

 
• Option - (2) : FYI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5bafa1fa073229e5616bfbbabe5cef3ee23e52cd065ab3d7eb60266e29ff3e7.png] ​

 
• Option - (3) : RKU

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68d37a7afa52686fd204cfd54901d1f14f84cfeee15dcad45f498b7d6f32b412.png] 

 
• Option - (4) : KDN​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6942f6ec4ca371edcea06cec4c1643ca64069b75f8fbba5503545255eb6d8ef.png] ​

Here,** Only 'CGB' **difference between first two and last two letter's position value is 4 and 5 respectively according to English alphabetic series.

Hence, the correct answer is "**CGB**".
